name: Seventy
overview: Scripture reveals the significance of the number seventy in God's governance and prophetic timing. Seventy elders were appointed by Moses to assist in leading Israel, as recorded in Exodus 24 and Numbers 11, where the Spirit of the LORD empowered them to prophesy and guide the people. Additionally, the period of seventy years symbolizes a divinely ordained time of judgment and restoration, exemplified by the captivity of the Jews in Babylon as declared in Jeremiah 25. These instances highlight God's sovereign order and fulfillment of His purposes through the number seventy.
